court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Sonoma
case_search_note: Odyssey case portal (linked from /online-services/case-portal); registration plus a separate access request is required per the court's public portal guide. The Criminal Division page separately says the court does not provide case information via the Internet and offers public terminals at the Hall of Justice, 625 Administration Dr. If you can't find a case call the criminal clerk (707) 521-6620.

courthouses.name: Hall of Justice
courthouses.hours: Building Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m. Criminal clerk office 8:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m.; criminal phone line staffed 8:00 a.m.–noon.
courthouses.note: Cases served: Criminal, Traffic, Juvenile Dependency, Mental Health. Felony, misdemeanor and certain infraction matters heard Mon–Fri; daily calendars posted on the first floor. Records Dept (707) 521-6670. The court relocated clerk's offices and courtrooms to 625 Administration Dr. in summer 2026 — older forms/pages still show 600 Administration Dr.; confirm your courtroom before going.

legal_aid.name: Sonoma County Public Defender — Post-Conviction Relief
legal_aid.what: Dismissal (expungement-type) petitions, PC 17(b) felony-to-misdemeanor reductions, PC 1473.7 immigration vacatur, Racial Justice Act (PC 745), SB 483 enhancement repeal, PC 1170.91 veterans resentencing, youthful offender parole. Call first if you think you qualify; page also explains self-filing CR-180/CR-181.
